calculate_list_scores.lua_script:
-- 将 item 级别的 flat list 聚合为 list 级别的分数（加法或位置衰减加权求和）
                  -- raw_list: 长度为 list_num*rerank_list_item_size 的 flat list
                  -- 返回长度为 list_num 的 list 级别分数数组（仅对前 rerank_list_true_num 个 list 计算）
                  local function aggregate_to_list_level(raw_list, list_num, true_num)
                    local agg = {}
                    for i = 1, list_num do
                      local start_idx = (i - 1) * rerank_list_item_size
                      local s = 0.0
                      if i <= true_num then
                        for j = 1, rerank_list_item_size do
                          local v = raw_list ~= nil and (raw_list[start_idx + j] or 0.0) or 0.0
                          if enable_position_decay == 1 then
                            s = s + v * (1 / (0.3 + j^0.6))
                          else
                            s = s + v
                          end
                        end
                      end
                      agg[i] = s
                    end
                    return agg
                  end

                  -- 序融合（Order-based ES）：在 list_num 个 list 级别分数上做 ES 排名融合
                  -- list_score_weight_pairs: {{list=list_level_scores, weight=w}, ...}
                  -- 返回长度为 list_num 的 es_scores（初始均为 1.0，逐步累乘）
                  local function calc_order_es_scores(list_num, list_score_weight_pairs)
                    local EPS = 1e-9
                    local es_scores = {}
                    for i = 1, list_num do
                      es_scores[i] = 1.0
                    end

                    for _, pair in ipairs(list_score_weight_pairs) do
                      local score_list = pair.list
                      local weight = pair.weight

                      -- 构建 (index, score) 对并按 score 降序排序
                      local score_pairs = {}
                      for i = 1, list_num do
                        local s = score_list ~= nil and (score_list[i] or 0.0) or 0.0
                        score_pairs[i] = {idx = i, score = s}
                      end
                      table.sort(score_pairs, function(a, b) return a.score > b.score end)

                      -- 按排名累乘，分数相同时复用上一个 rank
                      local rank = 0
                      for i = 1, #score_pairs do
                        local sp = score_pairs[i]
                        if i == 1 or math.abs(sp.score - score_pairs[i-1].score) > EPS then
                          rank = i
                        end
                        es_scores[sp.idx] = es_scores[sp.idx] * (1.0 / (rank + 10.0)) ^ weight
                      end
                    end

                    return es_scores
                  end

                  function calculate_list_scores()
                    local n = #context_pctr
                    if n ~= rerank_list_item_idx_flat_list_max_size
                      or n % rerank_list_item_size ~= 0 then
                      error("外部 fullrank 分数长度不正确或不能整除 rerank_list_item_size")
                    end
                    local list_num = n // rerank_list_item_size
                    local true_num = math.min(
                      math.max(rerank_list_true_num or 0, 0),
                      list_num
                    )
                    local context_scores = {}
                    if use_order_es == 1 then
                      local list_score_weight_pairs = {}
                      if context_pctr_weight > 0 then list_score_weight_pairs[#list_score_weight_pairs+1] = {list=aggregate_to_list_level(context_pctr, list_num, true_num), weight=context_pctr_weight} end
                      if context_pwtd_weight > 0 then list_score_weight_pairs[#list_score_weight_pairs+1] = {list=aggregate_to_list_level(context_pwtd, list_num, true_num), weight=context_pwtd_weight} end
                      if context_pltr_weight > 0 then list_score_weight_pairs[#list_score_weight_pairs+1] = {list=aggregate_to_list_level(context_pltr, list_num, true_num), weight=context_pltr_weight} end
                      if context_pcmtr_weight > 0 then list_score_weight_pairs[#list_score_weight_pairs+1] = {list=aggregate_to_list_level(context_pcmtr, list_num, true_num), weight=context_pcmtr_weight} end
                      if context_pwtr_weight > 0 then list_score_weight_pairs[#list_score_weight_pairs+1] = {list=aggregate_to_list_level(context_pwtr, list_num, true_num), weight=context_pwtr_weight} end
                      if context_plvtr_weight > 0 then list_score_weight_pairs[#list_score_weight_pairs+1] = {list=aggregate_to_list_level(context_plvtr, list_num, true_num), weight=context_plvtr_weight} end
                      if context_psvtr_weight > 0 then list_score_weight_pairs[#list_score_weight_pairs+1] = {list=aggregate_to_list_level(context_psvtr, list_num, true_num), weight=context_psvtr_weight} end
                      if context_pftr_weight > 0 then list_score_weight_pairs[#list_score_weight_pairs+1] = {list=aggregate_to_list_level(context_pftr, list_num, true_num), weight=context_pftr_weight} end
                      context_scores = calc_order_es_scores(list_num, list_score_weight_pairs)
                    else
                      for i = 1, list_num do
                        local context_score = 0.0
                        if i <= true_num then
                          local start_idx = (i - 1) * rerank_list_item_size
                          for j = 1, rerank_list_item_size do
                            local item_idx = start_idx + j
                            local element_score = 0.0
                            if use_multiply == 1 then
                              local multiply_score = 1.0
                              if context_pctr_weight > 0 then
                                multiply_score = multiply_score * ((1.0 + context_pctr[item_idx] * 4.0) ^ context_pctr_weight)
                              end
                              if context_pltr_weight > 0 then
                                multiply_score = multiply_score * ((1.0 + context_pltr[item_idx] * 4.0) ^ context_pltr_weight)
                              end
                              if context_pcmtr_weight > 0 then
                                multiply_score = multiply_score * ((1.0 + context_pcmtr[item_idx] * 2.0) ^ context_pcmtr_weight)
                              end
                              if context_pwtr_weight > 0 then
                                multiply_score = multiply_score * ((1.0 + context_pwtr[item_idx] * 4.0) ^ context_pwtr_weight)
                              end
                              element_score = multiply_score
                            else
                              element_score =
                                context_pwtd_weight * context_pwtd[item_idx]
                                + context_pctr_weight * context_pctr[item_idx] * 10.0
                                + context_plvtr_weight * context_plvtr[item_idx] * 10.0
                                + context_psvtr_weight * (1.0 - context_psvtr[item_idx]) * 10.0
                                + context_pltr_weight * context_pltr[item_idx] * 100.0
                                + context_pcmtr_weight * context_pcmtr[item_idx] * 100.0
                                + context_pwtr_weight * context_pwtr[item_idx] * 100.0
                                + context_pftr_weight * context_pftr[item_idx] * 100.0
                            end
                            if enable_position_decay == 1 then
                              context_score = context_score + element_score * (1 / (0.3 + j^0.6))
                            else
                              context_score = context_score + element_score
                            end
                          end
                        end
                        context_scores[i] = context_score
                      end
                    end

                    local scores = {}
                    for i = 1, list_num do
                      if i <= true_num then
                        scores[i] = (context_scores[i] or 0.0)
                          + expected_list_watch_time_weight
                          * (expected_list_watch_time[i] or 0.0)
                          + expected_list_engagement_weight
                          * (expected_list_engagement[i] or 0.0)
                          + expected_consume_length_weight
                          * (expected_consume_length[i] or 0.0)
                      else
                        scores[i] = 0.0
                      end
                    end
                    return context_scores, scores
                  end

rerank_list_padding_default_value.lua_script:
function calculate()
                  if rerank_list_item_idx_flat_list == nil or #rerank_list_item_idx_flat_list % rerank_list_item_size ~= 0 then
                    error("rerank_list_item_idx_flat_list为空或者长度不能整除 rerank_list_item_size")
                  end
                  local rerank_list_true_num = #rerank_list_item_idx_flat_list // rerank_list_item_size
                  local padded = {}
                  for i, v in ipairs(rerank_list_item_idx_flat_list) do
                    padded[i] = v
                  end
                  for i = #rerank_list_item_idx_flat_list + 1, rerank_list_item_idx_flat_list_max_size do
                    padded[i] = -1
                  end
                  return padded, rerank_list_true_num
                end
